label: B — forced-gate transient, phase x width x polarity

axes.note: 16 equally spaced phases of one switching period. Phase dependence is the point: what a forced gate does depends on where in the cycle it lands, so phase is swept rather than sampled.
Placeholder pulse widths spanning a decade. Widths that matter come from device test data, not from this simulator.
Both polarities: a forced-on and a forced-off gate are different faults with different consequences.

criteria.note: Placeholder undervoltage floor, judged on min_last_half rather than the whole-run min. A whole-run extremum is dominated by the start-up transient and would score every point identically regardless of the injected event.
Placeholder saturation current for the inductor. Describes no real part.
Placeholder blocking-voltage derating limit standing in for an ECSS-Q-ST-30-11C style rule.
